steps: GUI planning, build and actual Godot run select protocol 8. Two bindings of one strict generated controller retain observed / idle because the event is published before the second binding subscribes; both states select the same clip. The snapshot reports the real script state and retains distinct binding identities; six executed command receipts remain separate.
Read-only snapshot rows retain their binding filter and separate accepted state / executed command sequence in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px, with no horizontal overflow.

Binding and script source buttons navigate through the existing editor to their frozen source locations. Building, running, filtering, language changes and navigation leave every author file unchanged.
